name: booknest-cloudflare-app
description: BookNest 線上書店管理系統（Cloudflare Workers + D1）

scripts.db:create: wrangler d1 create booknest-db --location apac --binding DB --update-config
scripts.db:check:local: wrangler d1 execute booknest-db --local --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS book_count FROM books; SELECT COUNT(*) AS category_count FROM categories;"
